module origen_072467(
    output reg [15:0] out,
    input [15:0] mem_in,
    input write,
    input reset,
    input clock
);

    reg [15:0] mem [0:7];
    reg [33:0] cache_data [0:7];
    reg [15:0] hit;
    wire [3:0] replaceline;
    reg [7:0] used;

    integer i;

    initial begin
        $readmemh("memory.hex", mem);
    end

    always @(posedge clock or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                cache_data[i] <= 34'b0;
            end
            hit <= 16'b0;
            used <= 8'b0;
        end else begin
            cache_data[0][33:18] <= mem_in;
            
            hit <= 16'b0;
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                if (cache_data[i][33:18] == mem_in) begin
                    hit[i] <= 1'b1;
                    used[i] <= 1'b1;
                end
            end

            if (hit == 16'b0) begin
                $display("miss");
            end

            if (&used) begin
                used <= 8'b0;
            end

            if (write) begin
                for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                    if (hit[i]) begin
                        if (cache_data[i][0]) begin
                            // Write-back logic (not implemented)
                        end
                        cache_data[i][17:2] <= mem_in;
                        cache_data[i][0] <= 1'b1; // Set dirty bit
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    // LRU replacement logic (not fully implemented)
    assign replaceline = ~used[3:0] & used[7:4];

endmodule

module testbench;
    reg [15:0] mem_in;
    reg write, reset, clock;
    wire [15:0] out;

    cache_memory uut (
        .out(out),
        .mem_in(mem_in),
        .write(write),
        .reset(reset),
        .clock(clock)
    );

    initial begin
        clock = 0;
        forever #5 clock = ~clock;
    end

    initial begin
        reset = 1;
        write = 0;
        mem_in = 16'h0000;
        #10 reset = 0;

        // Test memory accesses
        #10 mem_in = 16'h0001;
        #10 mem_in = 16'h0002;
        #10 mem_in = 16'h0003;
        #10 mem_in = 16'h0004;
        #10 mem_in = 16'h0005;
        #10 mem_in = 16'h0006;
        #10 mem_in = 16'h0007;
        #10 mem_in = 16'h0008;

        #10 $finish;
    end

    initial begin
        $dumpfile("cache_memory.vcd");
        $dumpvars(0, testbench);
    end
endmodule
